normalization: A real OMP session in which a three-step bash command was backgrounded by a steering message and its result arrived later as an async-result custom_message. The committed JSONL keeps source lines 2-15 (the title padding line is dropped) and removes the providerPayload, usage, timing and contextSnapshot blobs from message records, including the provider's encrypted reasoning content. Every other field is as captured.
engine_events: omp-background-job-result.engine-events.jsonl is the output of `longhouse-engine parse --dump-events` (0.1.56-dev+c92873d5) on the committed JSONL with each event's raw_line omitted; the test maps it to render records the way the shipper's render_record does.
